perks.name: Sinew Stitching
perks.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving ? damage from Combatants or upon reaching Critical Health:
Spawns a Threadling.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Threadling spawns from damage and a 5 second cooldown between Threadlings spawns from reaching Critical Health.

perks.name: Knit Together
perks.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
The next 3 Threadling hits within 10 seconds of reaching Critical Health restore 50? HP.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown afterwards.

archetype.name: Brawler
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who love getting in the first punch.

Primary Stat: Melee
Secondary Stat: Health

item.name: Balanced Tuning
item.description: Slightly increases the three lowest stats on this armor at no cost.

item.name: Harmonic Scavenger
item.description: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.

item.description: Replenishes health each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
item.exact:

Restores 16 | 21 | 21 Health.
